plan.message:
Decode payload first. JSON [dictionary rows,body]. Build words in row order, numbered from 1. A string row is literal; [i,p,s,m] means first p characters of earlier word i, then literal m, then its last s characters (s=0 means empty). Prefix and suffix cannot overlap. Replace each ~N; in body with word N once, without rescanning; preserve everything else; print only.
